raw_response:
This plot is only 0.08 hectares of beans near my home, so I will manage it with my family’s labor and some compost we have from our cattle. I do not plan to buy chemical fertilizer for beans because they fix their own nitrogen, and the fertilizer from the cooperative is expensive and better saved for my teff or maize plots. I will plant the bean seed I saved from last year’s harvest and weed it by hand when the rains come, since it is too small to bother hiring workers for.
